decisions.issuer_claim: Comune di Rovigo confirms Verdi's Traviata in Teatro Sociale's 2026/27 opera programme, but publishes no showtimes in the issuer record.
decisions.external_claim: ClassicaLive publishes two separate dated event cards with exact venue and clock, both crediting the Comune event page.
decisions.cross_check_claim: Piazza in Festa corroborates both public clocks and distinguishes the 21 January rehearsal; page declares AI-assisted municipal-act compilation.
decisions.independence_note: The two ClassicaLive event cards share one publisher and Piazza in Festa may derive from the same municipal programme. Secondary corroboration is not multiple independent primary sources.
